headline: Foxconn records its highest monthly revenue in history, driven by demand for artificial intelligence
summary: Foxconn, the world's largest contract electronics maker, reported its highest monthly revenue in company history for July. The growth was driven by demand for artificial intelligence products, particularly servers.
why: Foxconn (Hon Hai) is the largest contract manufacturer of electronics, including Apple devices and AI servers, so its sales are a bellwether for the AI hardware supply chain.
